What gets in the way today

{{icon:circle-alert}}

Undisclosed debt

Borrowers submit audited statements that leave out recent charge creations or secondary bank loans.

{{icon:circle-alert}}

Slow underwriting

Checking charge registers across government portals by hand delays credit committee approval.

{{icon:circle-alert}}

No view after disbursement

It is hard to track whether a borrower stays compliant once the loan is sanctioned.
